clauses.reason: whole: EO 12121 (signed 1979-02-26, 44 FR 11195) amends Sec. 1-102 of EO 12083 by adding two members to the Energy Coordinating Committee, "The Director of the Community Services Administration." and "The Chairman of the Council on Wage and Price Stability."; its only command is that addition and it has no own-terms end. EO 12083 (held FR text of September 27, 1978) has no sunset: it establishes the Committee, with functions, an Executive Council and a revocation of EO 11814. First end: EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, 47 FR 36099), whose Sec. 20 reads "Sec. 20. Executive O rder No. 12083, as amended, establishing the Energy" (continuing on the next line: Coordinating Committee, is revoked). EO 12379 does not name EO 12121; it revokes EO 12083 'as amended', and because EO 12121's whole operative content is a textual addition to Sec. 1-102 of EO 12083, the revocation of EO 12083 as amended removes the section it amends and ends the clause (owner ruling 2026-10-21 unnamed instruments is respected: the end is the instrument that names the parent order as amended, and the reason is stated). EO 12379 has no effective-date wording, so the revocation is read as effective on signing, 1982-08-17. The OFR catalog note on the target reads "Revoked by: EO 12379, August 17, 1982". Later event: EO 12156 (signed 1979-09-10, 44 FR 53073) corrects EO 12148 Sec. 5-211 to a further amendment of Sec. 1-102 'as amended by Executive Order No. 12121' adding (z) the Director of the Federal Emergency Management Agency; that amendment adds a separate member and leaves the two members added by EO 12121 in place, so it is a later amendment event, not an end (owner ruling 2026-10-21 strike-and-insert). Disclosed alternative reading: if a reviewer holds that an order not named by number is not ended by the revocation of its amended parent, no first end is shown in the held sources.
